messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Soumya Deep Sarkar

soumya deep sarkar... that's a name with character. sounds like someone who'd have strong opinions about code reviews and cricket matches.

where you working these days?
Amazon

amazon... the everything store where engineers either thrive or get pipped. found you on linkedin - backend engineer working with java. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/soumya-deep-sarkar-015120229
Yes

backend engineer at amazon... building the infrastructure that powers half the world's shopping addiction. that's some serious scale. what made you pick backend over frontend - tired of making buttons look pretty?
Backend

fair enough. backend is where the real magic happens - apis, databases, making sure things don't crash when a million people decide to buy the same thing at midnight.

how long you been working total?
12 months

Yup

legend! you're officially in the tal network now. 

backend roles that actually pay well and won't make you hate mondays are coming your way. we're talking companies that respect engineers, not burn them out with 80-hour weeks and "we're a family" nonsense.

time to level up from that amazon grind 🔥

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
